description:
Create a physical security floor plan in EdrawMax for a server room (6m x 4m) with a single door. You must use the 'Security and Access Control' libraries (under Building Plan) to place specific devices. 

1. Draw a rectangular room approx 6m x 4m with one door.
2. Place and label the following devices:
   - Access Control: Card Reader outside door (Label: 'CR-01'), Push-to-Exit inside (Label: 'REX-01'), Door Contact on door (Label: 'DC-01').
   - Surveillance: Dome Camera in corner viewing entrance (Label: 'CAM-01'), Dome Camera in opposite corner (Label: 'CAM-02').
   - Intrusion: Motion Detector/PIR in center (Label: 'PIR-01'), Glass Break Sensor on wall (Label: 'GB-01').
   - Infrastructure: Control Panel on wall (Label: 'ACP-01').
3. Add a title 'Server Room Security Layout' at the top.
4. Save the source file as '/home/ga/Diagrams/security_plan.eddx'.
5. Export an image as '/home/ga/Diagrams/security_plan.png'.
